attributes.board_name: Texas Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored by AVMA and state/regional/local veterinary associations, accredited veterinary/vet-tech schools and other recognized organizations listed in Rule 573.65, or approved by the TBVME Licensing Committee or AAVSB RACE; live interactive online counts as live
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE completed before licensure does not count.
rules.audit_note: Sign/affirm CE on renewal; keep certificates 4 years for audit.

topics.who: Opioids/controlled substances every two years; only Board-listed courses count

rules.notes: 17 h annually; max 5 h non-interactive/pre-recorded correspondence, max 5 h practice management. Opioid/controlled substances hours only from the Board's list of approved courses.
